params.resolution: Each Burp check decides in its own Zh() by calling the point's Zgx0.Zr(config) (Ziqf.java:53 -> Ze9d.Ze). Checks that consult it, and so skip the listed session parameters: SQL injection (Zppj), OS command injection, path traversal, XML/XXE (Zp7s), SSI (Zexx), LDAP (Zwkf), external service interaction, and the XSS / template-injection engine (Zi6p.java:128, reflected and stored XSS, SSTI). Not gated: input returned, link manipulation, open redirection, header injection, client-side template injection. Ported in app/core/src/insertion.rs (SKIP_SERVER_SIDE) and the server_side() flag of every check in scan_checks.rs, test server_side_skip_list_gates_server_side_checks_only (commit ec380b4).
